# Palm Jebel Ali Resale · Mark Darsy

> palmjebelali-resale.com is Mark Darsy's independent advisory website for Palm Jebel Ali resale villas in Dubai (Nakheel's Beach and Coral Collections). Villas are compared by frond, orientation, plot relationship, outlook and the seller's remaining developer payments; buyers receive a shortlist of up to three options. Last updated 6 October 2026.

## Key facts

- Adviser: Mark Darsy, Palm Jebel Ali resale specialist, Regalia Tower, 1st Floor, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE.
- Contact: +971 58 541 4999 (phone and WhatsApp, https://wa.me/971585414999); mark@palmjebelali-resale.com; Instagram https://www.instagram.com/markdarsy_therealtor/.
- Track record: AED 200M+ in Palm Jebel Ali transactions advised on; direct acquisitions purchased from the developer, Nakheel; VIP access to selected developer stock and releases.
- Current resale asking prices (6 October 2026): 21 villas from AED 18M to AED 53.9M, median AED 21.5M; about AED 2,329–4,305 per sq ft (median AED 2,721). Asking prices, not valuations or achieved sales.
- Beach Collection: 5–6 bedrooms, about 7,316–8,434 sq ft (Nakheel brochures). Coral Collection: 6–7 bedrooms, about 11,222–12,165 sq ft.
- Construction (Nakheel, August 2026): 728 villas on Fronds K–P in internal and external finishing; 544 villas on Fronds A–F at various construction stages; phased handover of the first villas from late 2026 through 2027.

## Pages

- [Home](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/): Palm Jebel Ali resale villas with Mark Darsy: the shortlist service, featured villas, collections, construction progress and contact.
- [Villa listings (Property Atlas)](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/dubai-property-atlas/): Every Palm Jebel Ali resale villa currently presented, with frond, bedrooms, asking price, area, plot, orientation and a purchase cost estimator.
- [Villa prices](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/palm-jebel-ali-villa-prices/): Current Palm Jebel Ali resale asking prices by bedrooms, frond and price per square foot, with method notes.
- [Fronds A–P](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/palm-jebel-ali-fronds/): Frond-by-frond study: construction stage, resale asking prices, median price per sq ft and released designs for the twelve villa fronds.
- [Beach Collection](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/beach-collection-resale/): Beach Collection design library with Nakheel brochure built-up and floor-by-floor areas, architects and resale guidance.
- [Coral Collection](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/coral-collection-resale/): Coral Collection design library with Nakheel brochure areas, floor plans for Coral Dune and Sunset Mirage, and resale guidance.
- [Position Guide](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/palm-jebel-ali-position-guide/): How frond, orientation, position along the frond, outlook, neighbours and payments affect a villa decision; two-villa comparison tool.
- [Buyer guide](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/palm-jebel-ali-resale-guide/): Resale checks, how off-plan resale works, investor snapshot, Palm Jumeirah comparison, Golden Visa and DLD verification.
- [Sell your villa](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/sell-your-palm-jebel-ali-villa/): Confidential resale review and sale process for Palm Jebel Ali villa owners.
- [Owner valuation](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/palm-jebel-ali-owners/): Confidential valuation request, monthly market report and handover, leasing and resale support for Palm Jebel Ali villa owners.
- [About Mark Darsy](https://palmjebelali-resale.com/about-mark-darsy/): Who Mark Darsy is, his Palm Jebel Ali track record, how he works and how to contact him.
